note: 2-3 trigger/behaviour checks per skill (skill-creator convention). Each expected_output names the PRODUCT.md section + exit criteria the skill must satisfy. Re-run on change to catch drift from VISION.md.

evals.prompt: I have an idea for a product, help me start
evals.expected_output: Asks who/problem/why-now, benchmarks to current-year market, flags AI-or-not, writes PRODUCT.md#Vision with all fields; refuses to hand off on a fuzzy vision

evals.prompt: we keep adding features, what should the MVP be
evals.expected_output: Forces exactly one core feature + a non-empty OUT-OF-SCOPE list with triggers; writes PRODUCT.md#Scope; warns if #Vision missing
Core-first milestones, each with a testable exit criterion + rough timeline; writes PRODUCT.md#Plan

evals.prompt: what tech stack should we use
evals.expected_output: Picks stack benchmarked to 2026 OSS with one-line whys; names an adapter interface per external; records ADRs; writes PRODUCT.md#Architecture

evals.prompt: set up the project folder structure
evals.expected_output: Creates layered folders + .env.example + (AI) prompts/ YAML; writes STRUCTURE.md explaining each folder; writes PRODUCT.md#Structure

evals.prompt: get a basic skeleton running with CI
evals.expected_output: Runnable health path; config loader with fail-loud/fail-closed guard; structured logging; secret-scan; CI mirroring prod; verifies a config value actually flows; writes PRODUCT.md#Foundation

evals.prompt: define the data models and schema
evals.expected_output: Typed models + migration; schema↔code consistent; agrees units/scale at each boundary; writes PRODUCT.md#Contracts

Declares security-in-DoD; reuse scan; verifies the LIVE path (not just units); /code-review on diff; prompts in YAML; writes docs/features/* + PRODUCT.md#Build log with how-verified; flags if feature is OUT OF SCOPE

evals.prompt: is development complete, ready to test
evals.expected_output: Verifies each core feature runs + met exit criteria + security DoD with evidence; scope re-check; FAILS the gate (stops) if any box unmet; writes PRODUCT.md#Dev-complete
Unit (isolated) + integration (real contracts) + live-path + adversarial/security (injection for AI, authz); writes PRODUCT.md#Tests; refuses if only isolated units
Defines a measurable 'good'; measures against representative inputs; separates operational failures from quality; emits a confidence score; writes PRODUCT.md#Evaluation

evals.prompt: ship this feature and open a PR
evals.expected_output: Deep /code-review (traces callers) + /security-review + /doc-audit reconcile + confidence score + github-pr-flow PR + handoff; STOPS if a doc claim doesn't match code; writes PRODUCT.md#Ship log
Captures the success metric result; short retro; decides next FROM EVIDENCE re-checked against vision + OUT-OF-SCOPE; writes PRODUCT.md#Learnings

evals.prompt: are we still on track or did we drift
evals.expected_output: Cross-checks built features vs OUT-OF-SCOPE (creep), direction vs vision, milestones vs core-first, and code↔docs via /doc-audit; gives an honest verdict; does not advance the chain
